source.retrieval: GitHub MCP fetch_file at immutable commit; Git blob SHA-1 recomputed locally

extraction.method: Restricted literal-only parser; objects, arrays, strings, numbers, booleans, null and undefined only. No eval, imports, functions or upstream code executed.
extraction.undefinedObjectProperties: omitted, equivalent to JSON.stringify of the literal data
extraction.root: trustedRootJSON from trust.ts; full upstream public fixture root retained
extraction.artifact: Exact UTF-8 bytes of public upstream ARTIFACT: hello, world!; no trailing newline
extraction.signedBytes: Certificate, log-body, proof/checkpoint, signature, digest, timestamp and DSSE base64 payload fields copied without modification; outer JSON whitespace changed and listed unsigned protobuf default fields omitted.
extraction.outerEncoding: Root and bundle JSON: canonical minified JSON.stringify encoding with one terminal LF; adapter accepts zero or one terminal LF only.

normalization.admission: Logical JSON must deep-equal the pinned SDK protobuf roundtrip before cryptographic verification; ambiguous one-of and noncanonical base64 inputs refuse.
normalization.signedBytes: All fields except the listed unsigned protobuf defaults remain deep-equal to the extracted source; certificate, payload, log-body, proof/checkpoint, timestamp and signature bytes are unchanged.
normalization.cryptographicProbe: Both normalized fixture bundles accepted by installed pinned SDK with CT=1, tlog=1, timestamp=1; fixture-only trust.

extraction.fixtureEncoding: The .sigstore files contain pinned raw JSON bytes; the byte-oriented extension prevents general JSON formatting from changing canonical test evidence.

message.expectedCryptographicResult: accept under the fixture-only root; no approved-fork policy admission
message.transparencyProof: Rekor v2 Merkle inclusion proof and signed checkpoint
message.timestamp: included RFC3161 timestamp; default threshold1 retained

dsse.expectedCryptographicResult: accept under the fixture-only root; text/plain payload is not an in-toto release statement
dsse.transparencyProof: Rekor v2 Merkle inclusion proof and signed checkpoint
dsse.timestamp: included RFC3161 timestamp; default threshold1 retained

expected.approvedForkPolicy: refuse: these fixtures do not establish jorge123255/openbotv release workflow, approved tag or immutable repository/owner identities
